data.name: Warriors Across Worlds
data.detailed_description:
Get ready for the next generation of Warriors! After a brutal battle with a new threat, three Warriors are separated and are forced to survive in strange, new worlds with only their wits about them. They’ll meet familiar faces and fight alongside them in an attempt to stop the Desolate Demon from combining the Desolate Dimension with their dimension. Featuring fact-paced, turn-based JRPG combat and an explosive soundtrack you’re sure to remember; this is a JRPG that’s gonna take you on a wild ride.

Features:

  • Three main playable characters that put in work and three supporting characters that provide their own benefits and keep the main characters mentally sane during their adventure.

  • Explore the mysterious worlds of Zuld, Meelon, Even Newer York, and the Floating Islands. You’ll get to see a forest, a prison, the equivalent of Hell, some islands, the future, poison swamps, the inside of something, and a prism world.

  • Over 100 new attacks! Each one is flashier than the last.

  • A lot of banter between characters that’ll make you laugh. There’s even side-conversations that’ll randomly appear now and again.

  • Animated cutscenes! Several segments of the story are fully animated to help better immerse the player.

  • A soundtrack of over 50 songs composed by me! I hope you like drum & bass!

  • 7 difficulty options! If you want a leisurely stroll or an absolute onslaught, this game has you covered. (W.M.D. is ONLY meant for JRPG experts. Maybe even beyond expert, like super-expert.)

  • Over 40 achievements! Can you collect them all?

  • View artwork of the characters, battle backgrounds, and moments from the story in the Gallery!

  • EP Styles: Select from 10 different styles to best fit your playstyle and help you perform devastating, ultimate attacks! (Beyond the standard 9999 maximum, you get to see the exact amount of damage you inflict).

  • Six new, unique classes! Wield the power of Space, Time, Doom, Dread, Blood, and Storm! 

  • An Enemy Guide that shows you every detail about an enemy with special dialogue for each one!

  • Wanna move faster? Just Boost with a press of a button!

All of that and more awaits you in this badass JRPG!

data.short_description: Even When Separated, Miracles Can Happen. A short, indie JRPG about what happens when the dimension's strongest team gets split apart. They'll meet new friends and foes...mostly foes.

content_descriptors.notes: There's a lot of swearing. Like a LOT. There's also a chapter that's dedicated to being kind of creepy with mildly disturbing imagery. The imagery includes: Blood, Large Eyes, and the fact that you're in the insides of a creature.
